versions.changelog:
Initial release of furniture-fit-checker.

- Checks if furniture fits through doors, hallways, stairs, and in rooms using moving-industry geometry (including diagonal and corner turns).
- Warns about walkway minimums, door and obstruction clearances, and radiators/vents.
- Generates an ASCII floorplan to preview furniture layout and walkways.
- Supports both metric and imperial units.
- Includes command-line tool recipes and a detailed user guide.
